relations.subject: Paulinus a Sancto Bartholomaeo
relations.evidence: studies of theology in Prague and of Oriental languages at College of St.Pancratius in Rome.

relations.subject: Paulinus a Sancto Bartholomaeo
relations.evidence: In 1779-82 Rector of Verapoly Seminary, then Vicar-General and Apostolic Visitator of Malabar.

relations.subject: Paulinus a Sancto Bartholomaeo
relations.evidence: he became in 1790 Professor of Oriental Languages at the Mission Seminary of San Pancrazio

relations.subject: Paulinus a Sancto Bartholomaeo
relations.evidence: Also private secretary of Stefano Borgia.

relations.subject: Alter
relations.evidence: move to Padova and Vienna (where he taught some Sanskrit to Alter).

relations.subject: Paulinus a Sancto Bartholomaeo
relations.evidence: he became Prefect of studies at the Urban College of Propaganda in 1803 and remained there until his death.
